strings.تجديد الحمام بعد التكسير في الكويت: مراح: Bathroom renovation after demolition in Kuwait: checks before tiling
strings.خلص تكسير الحمام وتبي تبدأ السيراميك؟ قب: Finished cracking baths and tpe start ceramics? Before choosing the first row, make sure that the service stages, surface processing and insulation required are completed and checked according to the system used. In the renovation of the crushing baths, some of the most important works disappear under finishing; so reviewing them in time is clearer than relying on the beauty of the result alone.
strings.تصميم توضيحي لحمام أثناء إزالة السيراميك: Illustrative design of a bath during ceramic removal and wall preparation for renovation
strings.تصميم توضيحي مولّد بالذكاء الاصطناعي، ول: AI-generated illustration, not a photograph of a completed Almusaileem project.
strings.إذا تخطط لتجديد حمامك في الكويت، ناقش مع: If you plan to renovate your bathroom in Kuwait, discuss with Almusaileem Paints & Decor the desired finishing form and execution limits, and determine who handles specialized plumbing, electrical and insulation work. Interstage coordination makes each party know when to receive the area and what needs to be done before it.
strings.راجع مواقع المغسلة والمرحاض والشاور مع م: Review the location of the sink, toilet and shower with actual cut sizes, not just in a similar way. Differing dimensions may affect the door, cabinet and glass location. Submit certified product data, and ask to be sure it is suitable for the site before closing extensions.
strings.لا تنقل نقطة صرف لمجرد أنها تبدو أجمل في: Do not move the drain point just because it looks prettier in the drawing. The specialist assesses the possibility of modification, the conditions of extensions and the building, determines what needs to be adopted. Electrical work inside the bathroom is left to a qualified specialist; decorative coordination does not do without a safety review and technical requirements.
strings.وثّق الأعمال التي ستختفي: Document the work that will disappear.
strings.اطلب تسجيل الفحوص المناسبة للخدمات بحسب: Request proper testing of services by project scope prior to coverage, with clear images of their routes and maintenance access panels. The homeowner is not required to conduct the tests himself; his role is to ensure that there is a known implementation and inspection official, and to retain what has been approved.
strings.اسأل عن طريقة الوصول مستقبلًا إلى الأجزا: Ask about future access to parts that need maintenance. A beautiful interface that closes a necessary port may complicate subsequent intervention. Preferably, the review of services should be a standalone point before handing over the area to the next layers team, rather than overlapping work without documentation.
strings.تُحدَّد معالجة منطقة البلل ونظام العزل و: The treatment and details of the wetting area and insulation system are determined by the specialist according to the situation and product instructions. The installation of ceramics is not confused with the completion of this stage. When adopting a certain system, the suitability of the layers, confluences and drainage areas is reduced, and its processing and processing times are tracked.
strings.Schluter في شرح اختبار الماء: Schluter in Explaining the Water Test
strings.أن الاختبار وسيلة لفحص جودة منطقة الدش ق: The test is a means of checking the quality of the shower area before installing the tiles. The test execution, timing and duration are determined by the specialist according to the system used; do not transfer the duration of one product to all materials. Request a documented result and process any note before covering the area.
strings.اعتماد التشطيب بعد قبول الأساس: Adoption of finishing after foundation accepted
strings.بعد قبول المراحل السابقة، راجع عينة البل: After accepting the previous stages, review the tile or finishing sample, the distribution of the pieces and the edges and their confluence with the threshold and glass. Discuss water drainage and ground levels with the specialist before adopting the final appearance. Do not rely on specifications for sliding or resistance to a material depending on its image; refer to the product data and its permissible use.
strings.اتفق كذلك على حماية الأعمال المنجزة أثنا: It was also agreed to protect the work done during the entry of the rest of the technicians, and the instructions for the first use of water and cleaning. There is no unified date valid for each system, and do not rush back to use because the external face looks dry. The approved information comes from the materials implemented and the status of the project.
strings.قائمة متابعة مختصرة لصاحب البيت: A brief follow-up list for the homeowner
strings.اعتماد توزيع القطع ومقاساتها قبل إغلاق ا: Approve the distribution of parts and sizes before closing services.
strings.تحديد جهة فحص السباكة والكهرباء وتوثيق ا: Identify the plumbing and electricity inspection body and document the results.
strings.مراجعة تجهيز الأسطح والعزل واختباره عند: Reviewing roofing and insulation processing and testing it at the appropriate stage.
strings.اعتماد عينة التشطيب وتفاصيل الحواف والتص: Adopt sample finishing, edge details and drainage.
strings.استلام تعليمات الاستخدام والصيانة مع الم: Receive usage and maintenance instructions with final notes.
